ai_summary: Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) reported robust unaudited standalone financial results for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended September 30, 2026), demonstrating significant year-on-year and sequential growth in both revenue and net profit. The company also confirmed no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from its preferential equity issuance and Non-Convertible Debentures, indicating strong financial compliance. The independent auditors provided a clean limited review report, stating no material misstatements or non-disclosures.
